concern: Modified nucleoside analogs with broad RNA polymerase inhibition
system_prompt: You are a senior medicinal chemist specializing in prodrug design and ADMET optimization. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Introduce a hydrophilic phosphate prodrug moiety to improve solubility and facilitate activation by cellular phosphatases.
modifications.rationale: The addition of a phosphate group increases the compound's hydrophilicity and allows for enzymatic cleavage by cellular phosphatases, enhancing bioavailability and activation at the target site.

modifications.description: Replace the phenyl moiety with a p-methoxyphenyl group to improve metabolic stability and reduce off-target interactions.
modifications.rationale: The p-methoxyphenyl modification can reduce non-specific binding and improve the metabolic stability of the prodrug by decreasing susceptibility to oxidative metabolism.

modifications.description: Incorporate an ethylene glycol linker on the nucleoside sugar hydroxyl to enhance membrane permeability.
modifications.rationale: The ethylene glycol linker can enhance the compound's lipophilicity and membrane permeability, improving absorption and delivery to intracellular targets.
